title: The Borrowed Alibi
author: Wendell Ravensworth
blurb: Mara Ravensworth, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
